“Our mission is to provide exceptional hair restoration services to our patients , helping them regain their confidence and achieve natural-looking results through advanced techniques and personalized care.”
We seek always to create & deliver value to you
Exceptional Results with Integrity: We don’t promise miracles.We offer transparency, knowledge, and personalized care, tailoring treatment plans to each unique patient.
Innovation and Excellence: We lead the way in hair restoration with innovative techniques like our signature Real-time FUE , setting new industry standards.

Education and Empowerment: We educate and empower individuals with ethical and honest information, helping them make informed decisions and raising awareness about misleading marketing and unscientific hair care treatments

Our mission is to deliver the world’s most advanced and scientific proven solutions for restoring natural hair . Our commitment to innovation ensures that we provide the most natural and sustainable solutions. We help individuals feel good about themselves by restoring their natural essence and self-esteem.

We strive to offer truthful, honest, artistic, skillful, and compassionate hair restoration treatments to people worldwide. Our vision is to empower individuals globally with the gift of natural, healthy hair , believing that hair is a vital part of one’s identity and self-esteem.

Dr. Alok Kumar Sahoo, MD (Dermatology & Venereology) from AIIMS (New Delhi), is a leading hair transplant surgeon in Bhubaneswar & Delhi. With a focus on hair restoration, Dr. Sahoo has transformed the lives of over 10,000 hair loss patients through his expertise and dedication to excellence.

Dr. Sahoo specializes in advanced hair transplant techniques, including Bio-enhanced FUE, body hair transplantation (BHT), and eyebrow and beard transplantation. His focus is on achieving natural-looking results while restoring hairlines, density, eyebrows, eyelashes, and more.
Hair restoration surgeon, Eugenix Hair Sciences, Gurgaon (2019-2021)
Visiting consultant at a national skin clinic, Rishikesh and Dehradun (2019-2021)
Best dermatosurgery video presentation award in acsi north zone workshop 2016, new delhi.
Bishnupriya devi award for best original article published in ijdvl, 2019.
Presented paper in innovation award in acsicon 2016, mahabaleshwar, maharashtra.
Presented poster on ‘radiofrequency ablation of recalcitrant hailey-hailey disease’ in acsicon- 2016.
Attended instructional courses on fillers, liposuction, laser lipolysis and laser sweat ablation, laser hair reduction and ipl in acsicon -2016.

Swaraj Dhar is a visionary founder dedicated to solving healthcare challenges through innovative technology. He is committed to addressing misleading marketing in healthcare sector especially hair and skin care products, actively working to demystify myths in healthcare. Known for his commitment to ethical practices, Swaraj believes in the power of technology to make healthcare more accessible, efficient, and impactful.

With 11 years of corporate experience as a growth-driven marketing leader, he excels in building high-impact strategies and partnerships. A management graduate from MDI Gurgaon, Swaraj has successfully built and scaled businesses, handling their conceptualization, GTM planning and scale-up. His expertise includes Sales set up, Channel growth marketing, team leadership, P&L management, customer lifecycle management and digital transformation.

What is a hair transplant? Hair transplantation is a surgical procedure where hair follicles from the donor site are moved to a bald or balding part of the body called the recipient site.
How long does the hair transplant procedure take? This varies, but generally, a hair transplant procedure lasts between 4-8 hours.

Does a hair transplant hurt? Since it is done under local anesthesia, most patients do not feel much discomfort at all during the procedure. There might be some mild pain in the time following the operation, but that can usually be controlled by pain medication.

How long does one take time to recover after a hair transplant? The initial recovery period is normally 1-2 weeks, but several months may be needed before the transplanted hair grows fully and the final result is seen.
Are hair transplant results permanent? Generally, yes, because the transplanted follicles are resistant to DHT, the hormone responsible for hair loss.
Can a hair transplant be done on everyone? Not everyone is a candidate. Ideal candidates are those with stable hair loss and sufficient donor hair.
What risks or side effects might a hair transplant have? Risks of the procedure include infection, scarring, unnatural-looking hair growth, and temporary hair shedding known as “shock loss”.
